name: Rinna
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Rinna is a person mentioned only in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Simon and belonged to the tribe of Judah. He is known exclusively through his place in the lineage and has no further actions described in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Rinna is mentioned as the son of Simon in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles. This is the only reference to Rinna in the entire Bible.
